protocol.primary: Per-run overall P99 FCT, all message sizes; mean paired percent reduction against fixed original Homa; all six workload/load means must exceed 10%.
protocol.secondary: Overall P95 and comparisons with HPCC/DCQCN are fully retained, including regressions. Confidence intervals across the ten independent repetitions.
protocol.policy: Configuration frozen before generation or inspection of final traces. Identical traces/topology/capacity/routing for all algorithms. No failed run or slow message may be omitted. Any future tuning must treat these final inputs as already observed development data and use a newly reserved validation set.
protocol.known_development_limitation: WebSearch P95 regresses while overall P99 improves; no claim of universal latency improvement.

guard.primary: Per-seed P99 FCT, all flow sizes; P95 and size bins are secondary. Compute paired improvement, never pool seeds.
guard.policy: All runs and failures preserved; all input flows must complete, no completion-window censoring; fixed start-time warmup. Identical traces, topology, routing, and physical capacity. Homa derives priorities from same complete input snapshot.

baselines.primary: Per-seed P99 FCT, all flow sizes; P95 and size bins are secondary. Compute paired improvement, never pool seeds.
baselines.policy: All runs and failures preserved; all input flows must complete, no completion-window censoring; fixed start-time warmup. Identical traces, topology, routing, and physical capacity. Homa derives priorities from same complete input snapshot.

policy: All prespecified workloads, algorithms and repetitions retained. Complete input identities and counts verified; no completion-window censoring. Independent P95/P99 calculation after fixed start-time warmup; mean of paired reductions, not pooled flows.
